description: Land Title Settlement Department - Attidiya South, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521002 (23/0368)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, ownership details, and land extent measurements. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
